It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 16, 2021}} The district encompasses the province's southern half composed of the municipalities of [[Bansud]], [[Bongabong]], [[Bulalacao]], [[Gloria, Oriental Mindoro|Gloria]], [[Mansalay]], [[Pinamalayan]] and [[Roxas, Oriental Mindoro|Roxas]] facing the provinces of [[Marinduque]] and [[Romblon]], and the [[Visayas]] region.{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 16, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Alfonso Umali Jr.]] of the [[Liberal Party (Philippines)|Liberal Party]] (LP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=August 5, 2022}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
